E.3. SERVICES AND UTILITIES

In urban areas, significant hazards may be encountered from underground
services such as electricity and gas. Particular attention should be paid to the
hazards resulting from damage to high voltage power cables, gas pipelines and
associated installations. Before any trial pits, probes or boreholes are
commenced in areas where there may be underground services, hand-excavated
inspection pits should be used to establish the presence or otherwise of all
such services. Hand-operated power tools may be necessary in inspection pits
to assist excavation through hard materials, but should be used with extreme
care.

E.4 WORKS DISRUPTING ROADS, STREETS OR FOOTPATHS

For works on or adjacent to public roads and pavements, the require-
ments of the Road Traffic (Traffic Control) Regulations (Government of Hong
Kong, 1983c) must be complied with. Reference should also be made to the
Code of Practice for the Lighting, Signing & Guarding of Road Works
(Highways Office, 1984).
